newsitem.title: USA: Steel of West Virginia names new COO.
newsitem.headline: Steel of West Virginia names new COO.

text.p: Steel of West Virginia Inc said Friday that Timothy Duke, formerly the company's chief financial officer and treasurer, has been named president and chief operating officer, and has joined the company's board.
The company also said Mark Meikle, formerly the company's corporate controller, has been named chief financial officer.
The company said Robert Bunting who, prior to Duke's election, served as president and chief operating officer, will continue in his positions as chief executive and chairman.
